title: Extension of $300 Government Payout to Long-Term Visit Pass Plus Holders who are Spouses of Singaporeans as COVID-19 Measures
what_it_is: Extension of $300 Government Payout to Long-Term Visit Pass Plus Holders who are Spouses of Singaporeans as COVID-19 Measures

sections.label: Solidarity Payment eligibility and support
sections.summary: The Solidarity Payment gives timely support to Singaporean households, extending the one-off $300 payment to Permanent Residents and LTVP+ holders with a Singaporean parent, spouse or child.

sentences.speaker: The Deputy Prime Minister and Minister for Finance (Mr Heng Swee Keat)
sentences.text: The Solidarity Payment is aimed at providing timely support to Singaporean households during this challenging period of heightened safe distancing.

sentences.speaker: The Deputy Prime Minister and Minister for Finance (Mr Heng Swee Keat)
sentences.text: Arising from concerns over some Singaporean families with non-citizen members, we decided to extend the one-off $300 payment to Permanent Residents and LTVP+ holders who have a Singaporean parent, spouse or child.

sentences.speaker: The Deputy Prime Minister and Minister for Finance (Mr Heng Swee Keat)
sentences.text: While Long-Term Visit Pass (LTVP) holders who are spouses of Singaporeans are not eligible for the Solidarity Payment, they are able to take up employment to support their families.

sentences.speaker: The Deputy Prime Minister and Minister for Finance (Mr Heng Swee Keat)
sentences.text: They also receive benefits as part of a Singaporean household, such as GST Voucher – U-Save rebates and special payments, and Service and Conservancy Charges rebates.

sentences.speaker: The Deputy Prime Minister and Minister for Finance (Mr Heng Swee Keat)
sentences.text: If they or their Singaporean family need further financial support during this challenging period, they may seek help through their MSF Social Service Offices, which provide assistance to those who fall into financial hardship.

sentences.speaker: The Deputy Prime Minister and Minister for Finance (Mr Heng Swee Keat)
sentences.text: The assistance provided includes the COVID-19 Support Grant.

sentences.speaker: The Deputy Prime Minister and Minister for Finance (Mr Heng Swee Keat)
sentences.text: We will exercise more flexibility when considering ComCare applications during this period, to ensure affected Singaporean families can get help.

sections.label: No denial of support
sections.summary: No one will be denied support just because of this particular status.

sentences.speaker: Mr Heng Swee Keat
sentences.text: No one will be denied support just because of this particular status.
